record.what_it_does: Cloud communications APIs: SMS, voice, messaging (WhatsApp etc.), verify, video, number management.
record.auth_notes: Account-level credentials only: API key/secret (Basic header) or JWT signed with an application private key. Digest auth for SIP trunking. No OAuth2 for third parties, so each end user would supply their own key/secret or application ID plus private key.
record.access_notes: Sign-up is self-serve with free trial credit and no card. Trial accounts are restricted: SMS only to a registered number plus a few verified test numbers, and voice only to the registered number. Removing the limits means upgrading to a paid, pay-as-you-go account. Not verified directly against current pricing pages.
record.api_breadth_notes: Messages, SMS, Voice, Verify, Conversation, Number Management, Application, Account, Reports, Pricing, Identity Insights, Redact and Audit APIs, plus Video.
record.mcp_notes: Official Documentation MCP server (hosted at https://documentation-mcp.vonage.dev/mcp, docs only) and a Server API Bindings MCP server, npm @vonage/vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings, run locally. A community telephony MCP server also exists.
record.blocker_notes: There is no OAuth2 flow, so users must paste their own API key/secret or JWT credentials. Real use needs a paid account with credit. A trial exists but is restricted to verified numbers. There is no dedicated sandbox.
